newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Monsanto expects Swiss to admit soy.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto expects Swiss to admit soy.

text.p: Monsanto Co expects that its gene-altered soy products will ultimately be admitted into Switzerland, after a decision by the Swiss government to delay approval for importing such products was announced Friday.
A European-based spokesman for the U.S. firm, commenting on the decision, said the company still expected to gain approval.

"That is a legal process, we are waiting to see how it proceeds. It doesn't change our position that the products have been approved around the world, and ... we expect it will be the same in this case," said Helmut Wagner, a spokesman for Monsanto.

The Swiss Federal Health Agency (BAG) had approved the imports, but the Swiss Federal Department of the Interior (EDI) said it decided to postpone a decision after some private citizens and other groups filed complaints.
The EDI said that it would probably make a decision on the imports in March. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
